_nota: English versions of WannaNow's own texts (textos.json) for /en/things-to-do-valencia-today/. Same keys (valencia.es slugs). If a slug has no English text, a generic English sentence per category is used.
semana-europea-del-deporte-2026: A week to get moving: open days at municipal sports centres and taster sessions to try new sports, in public spaces, on the beach and at sports facilities.
palau-de-la-musica-programacion-2026: The concert hall on the Alameda wraps up its September season: concerts by the Orquesta de València, the Municipal Symphonic Band and other music.
valencia-design-fest-2026: The design festival spreads exhibitions, talks, pop-up spaces and themed routes across the city. This week it overlaps with the Feria Hábitat València trade fair (28 Sep – 1 Oct).
cultura-als-barris-2026: Culture close to home in 24 neighbourhoods: comedy, theatre, concerts, dance, cinema and workshops. Until 4 October there is also free open-air zarzuela (Spanish operetta) on a stage truck.
jornadas-xats-salud-mental-y-cultura: Three days of meetings bringing together culture and mental health, with activities open to the public.
